passages.text:
[Overweight and obesity are rising in Canada (Canadian Health Measures Survey 2022-2024) > Measured obesity in Canadian adults > Key findings]
- Among adults aged 18 to 79, measured obesity prevalence rose from 25% in 2016-2019 (pre-pandemic) to 33% in 2022-2024. - Prevalence was highest among adults aged 40 to 59 (38% of males, 35% of females). Among adults 60 to 79 it was 35% of males and 33% of females. - The largest increase was among young adults aged 18 to 39, starting from 22% before the pandemic. - Statistics Canada notes that pandemic-related lifestyle changes such as reduced physical activity and more sedentary time may have contributed.

Among adults aged 18 to 79, measured obesity prevalence rose from 25% in 2016-2019 (pre-pandemic) to 33% in 2022-2024 [4]. Prevalence was highest among adults aged 40 to 59 (38% of males, 35% of females) [4]. Among adults 60 to 79 it was 35% of males and 33% of females [4].

**Sources**
[4] Overweight and obesity are rising in Canada (Canadian Health Measures Survey 2022-2024) - Statistics Canada, The Daily (2025-10-02). https://www150.statcan.gc.ca/n1/daily-quotidien/251002/dq251002b-eng.htm

**Where to get support**
- Most provinces: dial 8-1-1 to talk to a registered nurse (tell me your province for the exact service).
- Canada's Food Guide - https://food-guide.canada.ca ; a registered dietitian can personalise advice.
- Obesity Canada (patient resources, weight-bias-free care) - https://obesitycanada.ca
